questions.passage:
An empty shop is more than a gap in a shopping street. When several remain vacant, fewer people pass through, and the surviving businesses lose customers. Simply advertising the empty units has done little where the rent and the cost of fitting out a whole shop are beyond a new trader's reach.

A local partnership is now dividing several units into small shared spaces. Traders pay for a stall and basic services instead of taking on an entire building. The arrangement will not rescue every shopping street, but it tackles one reason premises stay unused. Reviving a high street may depend less on finding a single large tenant than on making room for several small ones.
questions.q: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
o: Why Small Shops Need Larger Buildings
The Cost of Advertising Vacant Properties
Giving Empty Shops a Shared Future
How Large Retailers Choose Their Tenants
questions.target: 从整篇主线概括复兴途径，而非选择背景细节作标题
questions.skill: 从整篇主线概括复兴途径，而非选择背景细节作标题
questions.answer_support: Reviving a high street may depend less on finding a single large tenant than on making room for several small ones.

exp.trans: 空铺加剧街区衰落，整间租用费用又阻挡小商户进入；共享铺位降低门槛，为街区复兴提供一种途径。
exp.structure: 先说明空置问题和原有办法的不足，再解释共享方案及其适用限度。
exp.other: premises：经营场所；fit out：装修配备；tenant：租户。
exp.meaning: 正确标题覆盖空铺问题和共享利用的解决方向。它没有承诺所有街区都能因此获救。
exp.rest: 更大的建筑与小商户实际面临的负担相反；广告费用只是背景且非主线；文章不讨论大型零售商挑选租户。

questions.q: A marine reserve restored coral beds ten years ago. Now repeated heatwaves damage new sections every summer, and scientists call for continued monitoring. Which description best follows the timeline?
o: The reserve never achieved any restoration in the past.
The reef is now fully protected and no longer at risk.
The coral beds were already completely destroyed years ago.
Past restoration succeeded, but new damage continues.

exp.trans: 十年前恢复珊瑚，如今热浪每年损伤新区域，科学家要求监测。
exp.structure: restored与Now...every summer构成过去成果与持续威胁。
exp.other: coral珊瑚；heatwave热浪；monitoring监测。
exp.meaning: 过去成功不等于现在安全，持续损伤不等于全部毁灭。
exp.rest: 其余选项否认历史成果、夸大保护或虚构彻底毁灭。

questions.target: the big picture / 整体背景
questions.q: The emergency office assessed drought risk using only last week's rainfall. A researcher urged officials to examine five years of climate data and consider ______ before announcing a new water policy.
o: the next visitor
a single newspaper headline
the big picture
an unrelated complaint

exp.trans: 应急部门仅凭上周降雨量评估干旱风险；研究者建议在宣布新供水政策前查看五年气候数据、考虑整体情况。
exp.structure: The emergency office是主语，assessed是谓语；A researcher urged officials to examine... and consider...，两个不定式动作共同构成建议。
exp.other: drought 干旱；rainfall 降雨量；climate data 气候数据；water policy 供水政策。
exp.meaning: the big picture是整体局面或全貌；与仅凭上周局部数据下判断形成鲜明对比，不是一个单独的大问题。
exp.rest: 下一位访客、某篇报道与无关投诉都不能概括五年的整体数据，无法解释作者要求扩大视野的目的。

questions.passage:
Small touring companies often struggle with expensive costumes and duplicated office work. A regional theatre network proposes a shared costume store and a single booking service. The store would let companies borrow items they otherwise had to buy. The latter service would take bookings for every participating company, so that each troupe would no longer need to maintain a separate ticket office.

Administrators have complained for years about answering the same enquiries through several offices. Sharing costumes may save money, but it would not remove that repeated work. The booking proposal is directed at that particular problem. The network hopes the joint office will leave staff more time to arrange school visits and local performances.
questions.q: The complaint about repeated administrative work is most directly answered by
o: buying fewer costumes for each production.
giving every troupe its own ticket office.
asking performers to handle audience enquiries.
providing a common booking service.
questions.target: latter指第二项；相同主题不等于相同作用
questions.skill: latter指第二项；相同主题不等于相同作用
questions.answer_support: The booking proposal is directed at that particular problem.

exp.trans: 服装共享减少购置费用，统一订票减少各团重复接待咨询；长期抱怨针对后者所解决的重复工作。
exp.structure: 先列措施并说明作用，再以长期抱怨限定需要对应的目标。
exp.other: troupe：剧团；enquiry：咨询；duplicated：重复的。
exp.meaning: 正确项对应第二项共同订票服务，保留latter的指向及其解决的问题。
exp.rest: 少买服装处理的是另一项成本；各设票房会继续重复；让演员接咨询没有被提出。

questions.passage:
A local newspaper wants subscribers to understand what their payments support. Its annual accounts separate printing, delivery and reporting costs. Payments to freelance reporters amount to a substantial share of the total, although each individual assignment may appear inexpensive when considered on its own.

The distinction between a single payment and the combined cost matters to the newspaper's plans. Reducing one small fee would do little if the same work then had to be purchased elsewhere. The accounts are intended to show where spending accumulates across a year, rather than suggest that the most visible invoice must be the most important one.
questions.q: The phrase "amount to" in Paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to
o: make room for.
fall short of.
depend upon.
add up to.
questions.target: amount to也可表示总计达到，不固定只记一种义
questions.skill: amount to也可表示总计达到，不固定只记一种义
questions.answer_support: Payments to freelance reporters amount to a substantial share of the total

exp.trans: 报社说明零散稿费合计占全年开支的重要部分，单项小不代表合计不重要。
exp.structure: 第一段呈现单项与总量差别，第二段解释核算全年支出的意义。
exp.other: freelance：自由职业的；invoice：账单；accumulate：累积。
exp.meaning: add up to对应总计达到。本题与“相当于形式”语境不同，要按宾语和上下文判断义项。
exp.rest: 留出空间、低于和依赖都没有表达累计占比的关系。

questions.passage:
The allotment association noticed that several plots stayed dry even when others were watered often. Members first suspected that a pipe leaked. A survey showed instead that the early watering slot was the only one available to both ends of the site, and gardeners living farther away could seldom arrive in time.

[Missing paragraph]

Under the new timetable, the outer plots could draw water in the evening, when more holders were able to come. The association later checked whether the former dry patches were still concentrated in the same part of the site.
questions.q: Which paragraph best fits the gap?
o: The committee asked each household to pay towards repairs, even if its plot had never suffered from a leak.
The committee set out different watering hours, with a later slot for gardeners on the outer plots.
The committee encouraged gardeners to choose plants that need less water during a dry season.
The committee found that plots near the gate had been divided recently and began to review their sizes.
questions.target: 困难、调整方案与结果的因果链
questions.skill: 困难、调整方案与结果的因果链
questions.answer_support: Under the new timetable, the outer plots could draw water in the evening

exp.trans: 外侧地块缺水，调查发现时段不合适而非管道漏水。空缺后写时段调整的作用。
exp.structure: 先排除漏水并找到排班原因，再应有建立新时段的措施，最后检查效果。
exp.other: allotment 分租的小块菜地，holder 使用者，draw water 取水。
exp.meaning: 正确段直接处理外侧地块的时段困难，也为后文的 new timetable 建立所指。
exp.rest: 筹修理费仍归因于漏水，耐旱植物与地块大小都没有解释后文为何出现新取水时段。

questions.q: No existing model explains the readings. They could conceivably point to a new process, although a faulty instrument remains another explanation. Which interpretation is justified?
o: A new process is a possible explanation, alongside an instrument fault.
The readings establish a new process and rule out an instrument fault.
The instrument fault has been confirmed by a separate test.
The new process is less likely than an instrument fault according to measured probabilities.

exp.trans: 现有模型都解释不了这些读数。它们或许指向一个新过程，但仪器故障仍是另一种解释。有依据的是两种解释仍可并存，新的过程只是可能性之一。
exp.structure: No existing model + explains + the readings。They指readings；could point to是谓语。although从句中a faulty instrument是主语，remains是系动词，another explanation是表语。
exp.other: reading 仪器读数；process 过程；faulty 出故障的；rule out 排除。
exp.meaning: conceivably没有把一种可设想的解释升级为发现。another explanation尤其限制了唯一性；也没有给两种解释排名。
exp.rest: establish ... rule out将可能性改成证实和排除；confirmed by a separate test虚构检验；less likely ... measured probabilities补出概率比较，原文没有量化数据。

questions.skill: who 定语从句 + that 宾语从句 + 主句谓语
questions.target: who 定语从句 / that 宾语从句
questions.q:
Applicants who believe that a longer résumé automatically proves greater ability often overlook the value of relevance.
哪组句法判断正确？
o: 主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 overlook
主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 proves；主句谓语 believe
主句主语 a longer résumé；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 overlook
主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 proves

diag.1: proves 属于 that 宾语从句，不是 who 从句的核心谓语；believe 也不是主句谓语。
diag.2: a longer résumé 是 that 从句内部的主语，不是整句主语。
diag.3: proves 是 that 从句谓语；整句主句谓语是 overlook。

exp.trans: 那些认为简历越长就自然能证明能力越强的申请者，往往忽视了“相关性”的价值。
exp.structure: 原始简单句① Applicants often overlook the value of relevance. ② Applicants believe something. ③ A longer résumé automatically proves greater ability. → ②把 something 换成 that 从句：Applicants believe that... → 再把②变成修饰 Applicants 的 who 定语从句：Applicants who believe that... often overlook...。所以整句主语 Applicants，who 从句谓语 believe，that 从句谓语 proves，主句谓语 overlook。
exp.other: applicant 申请者；résumé 简历；automatically 自然而然地/自动地；relevance 相关性。
exp.meaning: 看到 who 后先划到从句结束，再找主句谓语；who 从句里又可嵌套 that 宾语从句。
exp.rest: 把 that 从句的谓语 proves 误当成外层谓语，或把其中的 a longer résumé 误当成整句主语，都会错过：Applicants 是主句主语，believe 是 who 从句谓语，overlook 是主句谓语。

title-coverage.passage:
A school district has responded to falling reading scores by buying extra tutoring hours. The help is welcome, particularly for pupils who have missed lessons. Yet the district's own review found that frequent timetable changes were repeatedly interrupting the normal reading classes. Paying for more teaching after school leaves that problem untouched.

The tutoring contract may prevent some pupils from falling further behind. It should not become a reason to postpone a more awkward discussion about how the school day is organised. A system that regularly disrupts its own lessons cannot put matters right simply by purchasing additional ones. The extra help is useful; a dependable timetable is still essential.
title-coverage.q: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
o: Why Reading Scores Call for Rapid Action
Extra Lessons Cannot Repair a Broken Timetable
After-School Tutors Deserve Greater Recognition
How Families Can Help Children Read at Home
title-coverage.target: 标题须包含作者对现有措施不充分的评价
title-coverage.skill: 标题须包含作者对现有措施不充分的评价
title-coverage.answer_support: A system that regularly disrupts its own lessons cannot put matters right simply by purchasing additional ones.

exp.trans: 额外辅导有用，但正常阅读课不断被打断，作者主张处理课程安排本身的问题。
exp.structure: 先认可补救，再指出根因仍在，末段要求把改善基本安排纳入对策。
exp.other: dependable：可靠的；put matters right：纠正问题。
exp.meaning: 正确标题抓住额外辅导无法代替稳定课程安排的论点。快速行动与阅读下降相关，但不是作者最强调的区别。
exp.rest: 紧急行动只概括背景需求；肯定辅导教师、家庭阅读均非文章论证中心。

title-coverage.passage:
Applicants for a training grant used to submit the same address details to three offices. A mismatch between the forms could delay an otherwise complete application for weeks. After staff traced the problem, the offices agreed to use one shared form. The change was introduced within days, and most applications could then move through the system without repeated checks of identical information.

There is a temptation to judge a reform's seriousness by how long it takes. This case points the other way. The change was quick because the obstacle was specific and the people involved had authority to remove it. Speed did not make the improvement superficial; it spared applicants another season of unnecessary delay.
title-coverage.q: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
o: A Grant Scheme in Need of More Patient Applicants
The Risks of Sharing Information Between Offices
A Swift Reform with Lasting Practical Benefits
Why Major Reforms Must Begin with Longer Forms
title-coverage.target: 不把快速解决一律误判成临时补救
title-coverage.skill: 不把快速解决一律误判成临时补救
title-coverage.answer_support: Speed did not make the improvement superficial

exp.trans: 重复填表造成等待，统一表格迅速移除了具体障碍。作者强调迅速并不等于表面应付。
exp.structure: 第一段呈现原因、行动与结果，第二段明确评价速度与改革价值的关系。
exp.other: superficial：表面的；trace：查明；obstacle：障碍。
exp.meaning: 本文恰好支持快速且有效的改革。标题判断必须跟随材料，不能学成见到quick就排除。
exp.rest: 要求申请人更耐心、警惕信息共享或延长表格，均不符合作者对这次改革的肯定。

title-coverage.passage:
Public libraries have spent heavily on faster internet connections and new computers. For residents without reliable access at home, those investments matter. Yet librarians report that some visitors still leave without completing the task that brought them in. A working computer is little help to someone unsure how to fill in an online form or judge whether a message is genuine.

Several libraries are now assigning staff to offer short, practical sessions alongside the equipment. The service costs money and takes time away from other duties. But if public access is to mean more than a row of available screens, helping people use the connection deserves a place in the budget too.
title-coverage.q: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
o: Bringing Every Library Service Online
A Better Connection Is Only a Beginning
Making Public Computers Pay Their Way
Why Libraries Are Losing Their Readers
title-coverage.target: 标题概括问题与解决方向，不只复现一个话题词
title-coverage.skill: 标题概括问题与解决方向，不只复现一个话题词
title-coverage.answer_support: helping people use the connection deserves a place in the budget too

exp.trans: 图书馆配置网络和电脑后，部分读者仍缺少使用技能；作者主张把人员指导也纳入公共数字服务。
exp.structure: 从硬件投入的成效和不足，推进到实用指导的需求与经费，形成“连接只是起点”的论点。
exp.other: genuine：真实的；assign：安排；alongside：与……同时。
exp.meaning: 正确标题同时覆盖硬件有用和仅有硬件不够这两层观点，包含文章后半部分提出的支持措施。
exp.rest: 把所有服务搬到线上不是文章主张；让电脑挣钱误读了公共预算讨论；文章也没有说图书馆正在失去读者。

modal-stage.target: is trying to establish / would be introduced
modal-stage.q: An engineering association is trying to establish voluntary safety standards for battery repairs. Its report says common standards would be introduced if enough workshops joined the pilot. Which interpretation is supported?
o: The standards are being pursued, but are not yet in force.
The standards are already operating in every workshop.
The association has stopped pursuing the proposed standards.
The workshops finished drafting the standards before the pilot.

exp.trans: 一个工程协会正在尝试为电池维修制定自愿性安全标准。报告说，如果有足够多的维修点参加试点，就会引入统一标准。
exp.structure: is trying to establish是现在进行时，表示当前正在尝试；would be introduced是情态动词加被动语态，if从句给出条件。
exp.other: voluntary自愿的；standard标准；pilot试点；in force生效。
exp.meaning: is trying to establish说明制定工作正在推进；would be introduced说明预期/条件下将引入，并不表示已经完成。必须区分尝试、预期结果和已经生效。
exp.rest: 把预期结果升级成已经在所有维修点生效；把正在推进改成停止；把标准完成时间倒置到试点开始之前。

modal-stage.target: would be adopted if / 条件结果
modal-stage.skill: 条件性将来与完成状态
modal-stage.q: After a trial, a hospital report says a shared handover checklist would be adopted if staff approved the plan. Which statement is accurate?
o: The checklist is already used across every hospital ward.
Adoption depends on staff approval and is not yet complete.
The hospital cancelled the checklist after the trial.
Staff approved the checklist before the plan was first proposed.

exp.trans: 试点结束后，医院报告说，如果员工批准方案，就会采用统一的交接清单。是否采用仍取决于员工批准，并非已经完成。
exp.structure: would be adopted是情态动词加被动结构；if staff approved the plan是条件从句。
exp.other: handover交接；checklist清单；adopt采用；approval批准。
exp.meaning: would be adopted if...表示条件满足时预期采用，不能据此说已经在所有病区使用。
exp.rest: 把条件性计划说成全面实施；把医院取消方案当成原文事实；把员工批准提前到方案提出之前。

modal-stage.q: An archive memo says the old photographs need protection from damp air. It gives no account of whether protective equipment has been installed. What can be concluded?
o: The photographs require protection; current safeguards are unknown.
The photographs are already secured by effective equipment.
The photographs have all been irreversibly ruined by moisture.
The archive is planning to stop accepting photographs.

exp.trans: 备忘录提出防潮需求，但没有说明设备是否已安装。
exp.structure: need protection表达必要性；has been installed涉及完成状态，未知。
exp.other: damp潮湿的；safeguard防护措施；archive档案馆。
exp.meaning: 需要保护≠已经妥善保护，也不能断言此前完全没有防护。
exp.rest: 其他选项擅自确认保护成效、彻底毁损或停止接收。

modal-stage.q: After a cyberattack, a hospital report states that its network needs stronger access controls. A proposal has been drafted, but no installation date is recorded. Which claim is warranted?
o: The new controls have already been fully deployed.
Stronger controls are recommended, not confirmed in place.
Every hospital computer has been permanently disabled.
The attack proved all past network controls were useless.

exp.trans: 医院提出加强网络权限控制，有草案但没有部署日期。
exp.structure: needs表达需要；has been drafted只确认方案草案形成。
exp.other: deploy部署；access control访问控制。
exp.meaning: 建议加强不等于完成部署，攻击也不能证明全部过去措施无效。
exp.rest: 其他选项无依据地声称完成部署、全部瘫痪或旧控制全无用。

cloze-big-picture.q: A factory manager praised a production line after one unusually productive morning. The annual report, however, showed repeated delays and large repair costs. Which advice is best supported?
o: Celebrate the morning and ignore the report.
Look at the big picture rather than one exceptional shift.
Decide that the line has never produced anything useful.
Assume that annual costs are irrelevant to performance.

exp.trans: 厂长凭一次特别高产的上午就夸奖生产线，但年度报告显示反复延误及高额维修费。评价应着眼整体而非单次样本。
exp.structure: A factory manager + praised + a production line；however引出与单次乐观印象相反的长期证据；Which advice要求概括两边的关系。
exp.other: productive 高产的；annual report 年报；repair cost 维修费用；exceptional 例外的。
exp.meaning: look at the big picture表示看全局、顾及长期背景，避免单凭个别表现判断整体。
exp.rest: 只看那一个上午就是原文批评的做法；断言生产线毫无用处过度概括；完全忽略年度成本也背离证据。

former-latter-goal.passage:
A field station has been struggling with two different costs. Electricity bills have risen, and floods have repeatedly damaged equipment stored on the ground floor. Its new plan combines rooftop solar panels with raised storage rooms. The former measure should reduce the cost of running instruments during ordinary working days; the latter protects equipment when the river rises.

Staff have long complained that routine electricity costs leave too little money for field visits. The new storage rooms are welcome, but they answer a different concern. The raised rooms should prevent another expensive loss, but they will not lower the regular electricity bill. Managers plan to use the savings from the panels to restore trips that had been cancelled.
former-latter-goal.q: The staff's complaint about routine operating costs would be addressed mainly by
o: installing the rooftop solar panels.
raising the equipment storage rooms.
replacing instruments after another flood.
reducing the number of planned field visits.
former-latter-goal.target: former指第一项；核对措施与题干目的
former-latter-goal.skill: former指第一项；核对措施与题干目的
former-latter-goal.answer_support: The former measure should reduce the cost of running instruments during ordinary working days

exp.trans: 太阳能板降低日常用电成本，抬高储藏室防止水灾。员工长期抱怨的是常规电费挤占外出经费。
exp.structure: 两项措施并列后分别给出作用；第二段进一步限定题目所问的成本。
exp.other: former：前者；latter：后者；routine：日常的。
exp.meaning: 题干问日常运营开支，应对应前者太阳能板；不能因防洪也出现在计划中就选它。
exp.rest: 抬高储藏室应对水灾；更换灾后仪器增加另一类开支；取消考察不是文中解决电费问题的措施。

amount-to-meaning.passage:
A transport authority has invited residents to comment on a station plan after the main contracts have been signed. Officials promise to listen, but they cannot change the entrance, the route of the access road or the hours of construction. Only the colour of a boundary fence remains open for discussion.

Under those conditions, the consultation amounts to a formality. An opportunity to speak is of limited value when the decisions that matter have already been made. Public participation should occur while alternatives remain possible, not merely provide a final stage in a process whose outcome is no longer in doubt.
amount-to-meaning.q: The phrase "amounts to" in Paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
o: is effectively.
is caused by.
depends upon.
argues against.
amount-to-meaning.target: amount to在评价语境表示实际上相当于
amount-to-meaning.skill: amount to在评价语境表示实际上相当于
amount-to-meaning.answer_support: the consultation amounts to a formality

exp.trans: 主要决定已定，居民仅能讨论围栏颜色，因此所谓咨询实际只剩形式。
exp.structure: 前段提供受限范围，后段以amounts to对咨询的实质作评价。
exp.other: formality：形式性程序；consultation：征求意见。
exp.meaning: is effectively表达实际上等于、实质上是；本句不是数字总计，也不表示因果或反对。
exp.rest: is caused by改成因果；depends upon改成依赖条件；argues against改成持反对观点。

paragraph-order-discourse.q:
段落甲结尾：Not surprisingly, nearly half of the applicants withdraw before the final interview.
下面哪个段首与它的衔接最强？
o: Equally unsurprisingly, few of the remaining applicants receive an offer.
By contrast, the final interviews take place in the company's new building.
For example, managers from several departments attend the final interview.
In conclusion, a final interview is unnecessary for applicants who remain.

exp.trans: 甲段说“不出所料，近一半申请者在终面前退出”。最强衔接是：“同样不足为奇的是，留下的人中也只有很少一部分收到录用。”
exp.structure: Not surprisingly先给出一个“并不意外”的结果；Equally unsurprisingly显式要求前面已经有一个同类判断，再补第二个并列结果。两个副词短语构成明显篇章钩子。
exp.other: withdraw 退出；final interview 终面；a small share 少部分；receive an offer 获得录用。
exp.meaning: Equally / similarly / also 等段首词常要求前文存在可并列对象。排序题中这种平行措辞比泛泛的主题相似更可靠。
exp.rest: 换到面试地点没有形成真正对立；经理参会不是申请者退出的例子；也不能从退出比例推出剩余申请者无需面试。平行标记与申请者筛选链共同支持承接。

paragraph-order-discourse.q:
一篇先分析家电过早报废、后提出改进办法的文章，有一候选段写道：After examining the figures, Dr Patel sums up her proposal: shared repair services could help residents keep appliances longer. 段末又说：Whether enough households will join, however, remains an open question.
这一段最适合放在哪里？
o: 全文开头，用来首次介绍Dr Patel
问题分析展开之前
全文结尾附近，作为总结和改革建议
只能放在具体数据段之前

exp.trans: 考察数据后，Patel博士总结自己的建议：共享维修服务或许能让居民更长久地使用电器。但是否有足够多家庭参与，仍是未决问题。这段最适合放在结尾附近。
exp.structure: After examining the figures回看前文数据；Dr Patel + sums up + her proposal明确给出总结动作。末句Whether...will join作主语，remains...为谓语部分，以未决问题收束。
exp.other: sum up 总结；shared repair service 共享维修服务；appliance 家电；household 家庭；open question 未决问题。
exp.meaning: 总结建议与回顾数据、开放结尾合起来支持尾段位置；单独出现concludes或sum up并不能证明必为全文最后一段。
exp.rest: 首次介绍人物不能解释已分析过数据；在问题分析前放总结建议与给定结构不合；“只能放在数据段之前”更与After examining the figures相反。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 段尾问题 / 原因解释
paragraph-order-discourse.q:
前段：The theatre sold every seat at the advertised price. Yet the deposits in its bank account were smaller than the value of tickets sold. The manager began tracing the gap between bookings and payments.
哪个后段最能推进这一问题？
o: Audience surveys ranked music above scenery when asking about favourite parts of the performance.
The booking agency deducted its service fees before forwarding the remaining money to the theatre.
The theatre had used the same stage for years, although its audience changed with each production.
Rehearsals ended later than planned, so actors sometimes travelled home together.

exp.trans: 剧院按宣传价卖出了所有座位，但银行入账小于售票总额。经理追查订票与收到款项之间的差额。订票代理转款之前先扣除服务费，最直接解释这个差额。
exp.structure: The theatre + sold + every seat。deposits + were smaller than + the value of tickets sold是金额比较。正确后段中The booking agency + deducted + service fees；before forwarding说明扣款发生在剧院收到钱之前。
exp.other: deposit 入账款；advertised price 宣传价格；deduct 扣除；forward money 转款。
exp.meaning: 没有One reason或Equally等显眼连接词，也能由段尾的收款差额锁定后段的扣费机制。这是问题→原因，不是看见theatre或audience就接同主题段。证据来自金额和交易阶段，不是一个单词。
exp.rest: Audience surveys解释演出偏好，未说明钱款差额；same stage介绍场地历史，未接收款链；rehearsals和共同回家是演出活动信息，不解释代理转款前少了什么。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 表面便利 vs 参与不足
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 讽刺语气 + 对比过渡
paragraph-order-discourse.q:
前文：The online course called itself interactive, but students could do little more than click Next after each recorded lecture. The easiest part was operating the screen; the hardest was staying awake.
【空缺】
后文：What would genuine participation require? Students could challenge arguments and revise one another's work.
哪句最适合？
o: The simple controls already give learners an active role in shaping the course.
A redesign could replace passive viewing with a real role in shaping discussion.
Recorded lectures also let learners choose when to watch the same presentation.
Adding subtitles would make the recorded lectures easier for learners to follow.

exp.trans: 前文用带讽刺性的说法指出所谓互动课仍只让学生被动点下一页；正确句转向让学生真正贡献观点的另一种课程；后文追问真正参与需要什么。
exp.structure: but建立宣称interactive与实际只能click Next的矛盾；the hardest was staying awake暗示被动乏味。正确句用replace passive viewing with a real role in shaping discussion提出另一模式，后文再具体说明质疑论点与互相修改。
exp.other: interactive 互动的；lecture 讲座/课；challenge an argument 质疑论点；revise 修订。
exp.meaning: 看到操作很简单，不能自动判为作者赞扬。应结合转折、夸张和后文提问判断作者真正评价：被动消费不足，主动参与才是重点。
exp.rest: 操作简单不等于能参与建构讨论；自选观看时间和字幕提升观看便利，却没有补上后文要求的质疑论点、互评修改等主动参与。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 单向展示→反向参与→后文设问
paragraph-order-discourse.q:
前文：At the old science museum, visitors watched a machine demonstrate each experiment. The most demanding thing they could do was press the Start button.
【空缺】
后文：What counts as taking part in an experiment? Visitors must be able to change a variable and compare the results.
哪一句最适合？
o: Repairs to the building could give the passive displays a more attractive setting.
Simpler controls could help more visitors watch the same machine demonstrations.
More detailed labels could explain the inventors behind the museum's machines.
A redesign could replace watching demonstrations with carrying out one's own tests.

exp.trans: 旧科技馆由机器单向演示，观众几乎只能按开始按钮。正确句引出新展览如何扭转这种被动观看，让观众亲自试验；后文再问什么才是真正参与实验。
exp.structure: 前文visitors watched与could do ... press Start显示参与程度低；正确句replace watching demonstrations with carrying out one’s own tests对比观看与亲自实验，后文change a variable和compare the results说明这种参与如何实现。
exp.other: demanding 费力的；demonstration 演示；variable 变量；carry out a test 进行试验。
exp.meaning: 最有力的证据是双向：反转被动的安排承接前文，主动测试又引出后文讨论。‘最难任务只是按按钮’在语境中揭示参与不足，不是对设备的夸赞。
exp.rest: 场馆外观、观看操作和发明者标签仍把参观者放在观看或接收信息的位置；只有亲自测试自然引出后文改变变量、比较结果的参与标准。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: new funding mechanism / That consequence / topical two-group distractor
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 制度改革先说明执行机制，再由That引出合作结果
paragraph-order-discourse.q: A public library will stop funding children's and adult literacy programs through entirely separate budgets. Officials stress that the reform should strengthen both. [BLANK] That should produce more projects serving whole families, rather than two unrelated groups. Which fits?
o: The new process will require both programs to design projects together.
Regional libraries have published more reports about literacy this year.
Some employees focus on adult readers, while others teach children.
The board will create separate committees for each age group.

exp.trans: 图书馆计划取消儿童和成人识字项目完全分立的预算。改革目标是同时加强两者。随后要解释两项目如何一起设计方案，这才能使服务整个家庭的合作项目增加。
exp.structure: That回指空格中描述的具体做法；new process...design projects together才会自然导致projects serving whole families。两个研究群体的存在是话题背景，不是合作机制。
exp.other: literacy 读写能力；entirely separate 完全分开的；joint project 联合项目；committee 委员会。
exp.meaning: topic match≠discourse link：后句That should produce...是结果句，前句需要明确的行动或机制。如果只描述两个群体，读起来相关却没有形成因果链。
exp.rest: 发表报告不一定促进合作；成人/儿童分工只描述现状；继续成立独立委员会甚至背离整合改革的目标。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: policy integration / mechanism / This change consequence
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 空前改革目标与空后合作效果需要中间实施步骤
paragraph-order-discourse.q: A museum plans to replace isolated conservation and education grants with a shared application process. Its directors say neither department will lose support. [BLANK] This change could generate exhibitions linking research and visitor experience. Which fits?
o: The museum has recently seen a sharp increase in visitor attendance.
Staff will evaluate proposals jointly and choose teams to collaborate.
The departments have long published very different research reports.
The museum will divide each grant into two fixed independent parts.

exp.trans: 博物馆将把保护和教育研究的独立资助改成联合申请。管理层说两部门都不会失去支持。空格要解释联合评审并选择合作团队，才能顺接‘这一变化会产生连接研究与观众体验的展览’。
exp.structure: 空格前提供改革背景和意图；This change could generate...给出预期效果。中间需要能产生该效果的具体协作措施，而非笼统主题描述。
exp.other: conservation 保护、文物修复；grant 资助；jointly 联合地；exhibition 展览。
exp.meaning: 要核实桥接是否构成‘政策→机制→结果’链条，不能因选项也谈博物馆或部门就草率接受。
exp.rest: 游客增加和以往报告差异只是主题信息；再把资金硬分成两部分反而违背联合申请改革。

paragraph-order-discourse.q: An energy guide first explains that meter logs locate periods of high demand. A paragraph about equipment inspections follows. The next two paragraphs describe a bakery and a warehouse that combined logs with inspections. What is the role of the inspections paragraph?
o: It completes the methods that the later cases apply.
It summarizes the outcomes reported in the later cases.
It gives a third case after the bakery and warehouse.
It withdraws the claim that meter logs can be useful.

exp.trans: 能源指南先解释用电表日志定位高需求时段，再介绍设备检查；后面两个案例同时使用日志和检查。检查段是在补齐随后案例会应用的方法。
exp.structure: first、follows、next交代段落顺序；combined logs with inspections说明两个案例同时依赖前面两种方法，不是只应用第一段的方法。
exp.other: meter log 电表记录；equipment inspection 设备检查；high demand 高需求；apply 应用。
exp.meaning: 一个方法段结束，不代表下一段必须马上举例。要检查后面案例需要哪些方法说明，再分清并列方法与两则应用案例的层级。
exp.rest: 总结后文结果需要结果性内容，检查方法本身不能当作结果总结；它位于两案例前也不是第三案例；案例同时使用日志，并未撤回日志有用的判断。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 同关键词不等于篇章连接
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 同关键词不等于篇章连接
paragraph-order-discourse.q: Paragraph P: The seed collection has two packets called "winter bean". Records show that they came from different valleys and need different storage temperatures. Which paragraph should follow to address the problem just identified?
o: Winter beans also appear in recipes collected from cooks.
Each packet will keep its local name plus a unique code.
The collection began when a gardener donated bean seeds.
Beans become tender when heated for a sufficient period.

exp.trans: 两个同名种子包来自不同山谷、需不同储温。哪段最适合接着解决刚提出的问题？
exp.structure: two packets called同名与different来源/条件共同制造识别风险；后段需同时保留本地名和区分身份。
exp.other: packet小包；storage储存；unique code唯一编码。
exp.meaning: 主题词bean重复不足以证明相邻；唯一编码回应同名异物的具体关系。
exp.rest: recipes转到烹饪；collection began倒退背景；tender讨论烹煮，都没有处理同名种子识别问题。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 并列与递进的段落功能
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 并列与递进的段落功能
paragraph-order-discourse.q: P: Singers can practise difficult rhythms by clapping. Q: They can also hum the melody without words to check pitch. R: A rehearsal combines both exercises before restoring the lyrics. Which account of the paragraph roles is accurate?
o: P and Q are rival results; R rejects both as unsuccessful.
P explains a failure; Q supplies its cause; R changes topic.
P and Q offer parallel methods; R combines their use.
P is a conclusion; Q gives its premise; R introduces P.

exp.trans: P拍手练节奏，Q哼唱检查音高，R把两项合并排练再恢复歌词。段落作用是什么？
exp.structure: also标出另一方法；both回收前两种练习；combines才是从方法列举转向组合应用的推进。
exp.other: hum哼唱；pitch音高；lyrics歌词。
exp.meaning: P/Q并列而非彼此因果；R在并列方法之上推进到综合应用。
exp.rest: rival results...rejects虚构竞争和失败；failure...cause虚构因果；P is a conclusion颠倒介绍与总结的位置。

paragraph-order-discourse.q: An essay introduces software that restores damaged musical scores, shows one rhythm error it produced, and explains how musicians can check its output. Which closing paragraph best fits that argument?
o: Human checks help; useful output can still contain errors.
The history of ticket prices now needs a detailed account.
All restored notes must be right whenever software is used.
One rhythm error proves that every digital tool is useless.

exp.trans: 文章介绍修复乐谱的软件，展示一处节奏错误，再解释音乐家如何核验。哪段适合结尾？
exp.structure: 开头对象、错误例证、核验措施共同约束末段；结尾应合并优势与限制，不另起无关话题或扩大为全称断言。
exp.other: score乐谱；restore修复；output输出结果。
exp.meaning: 全局位置要检查论证链是否闭合；技术有用与仍需人类核验可以同时成立。
exp.rest: ticket prices另起无关话题；All restored notes把能力夸成保证；every digital tool把单例扩大为全体无用。

paragraph-order-discourse.passage:
A theatre began lending its old stage equipment to local groups in the spring. The storekeeper expected to spend most of her time showing borrowers what was available. The scheme grew quickly, and she soon discovered that keeping items in use required work that had been easy to overlook.

[Missing paragraph]

One of the first loans that spring shows why the return checks mattered. A group brought back a lighting stand with a cracked fitting. Because the storekeeper inspected it before putting it away, the fault was repaired before the next borrower arrived.
paragraph-order-discourse.q: Which paragraph best fits the gap?
o: The service set up a spring display so visitors could see which lights and costumes were available to borrow.
At first the theatre kept the store open late. The additional hours made it easier for groups to collect equipment.
The staff organised the work around booking, collection and inspection on return. Each task had its own checklist.
Demand was especially high for racks and tables. Several groups asked whether they could keep these all summer.
paragraph-order-discourse.target: 概述环节后再写较早的具体实例
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 概述环节后再写较早的具体实例
paragraph-order-discourse.answer_support: One of the first loans that spring shows why the return checks mattered

exp.trans: 剧院春季开始借出设备，材料空缺后用早期归还的一件器材说明为何要检查。
exp.structure: 前段留下维护流程的问题，后段以还件检查的实例展开。中间需先介绍借出及归还流程。
exp.other: fitting 配件，inspection on return 归还时检查，cracked 有裂缝的。
exp.meaning: 正确段把预约、领取和归还检查放进同一流程，提供后文 return checks 的依据。初期案例放在流程概述之后仍自然。
exp.rest: 展示、延长开放时段和热门设备都有同一借用主题，也符合春季时间，却不能引出归还时对器材的检查。

paragraph-order-discourse.passage:
A cooperative opened a shared workshop where small furniture businesses could hire machines by the hour. One group of owners thought the main benefit would be lower costs. After a year, the coordinator found that many members were also borrowing measuring tools, sharing suppliers and giving advice about how to train new staff.

The cooperative has therefore started measuring more than the number of bookings. It asks businesses to record when sharing equipment has led to an exchange of skills or a joint order. The coordinator wants those accounts to inform future decisions about which resources the workshop should provide.
paragraph-order-discourse.q: Which of the following would make the most appropriate final paragraph?
o: The new figures can show both how often firms hire the machines and how their work together has changed.
The new figures should help explain why workshop owners can now take on extra orders without speaking to other businesses.
The next step is to choose a single method of training so that every business can offer its workers the same instruction.
The chief task for the cooperative is now to decide whether the hourly rate can be used to estimate future building costs.
paragraph-order-discourse.target: 结尾须回收共同资源与长期协作
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 结尾须回收共同资源与长期协作
paragraph-order-discourse.answer_support: It asks businesses to record when sharing equipment has led to an exchange of skills or a joint order.

exp.trans: 共享车间的价值既有机器使用成本，也有人际协作。运营方开始记录设备共享带来的互助。
exp.structure: 从创办目标到观察到的新作用，再转入如何核算两类收益。
exp.other: cooperative 合作组织，joint order 联合订单，inform 为决策提供依据。
exp.meaning: 合适结尾同时回收机器使用与企业互助，也解释为何增加记录。
exp.rest: 不沟通就增加订单反转互助，统一培训方案添加政策，建造成本把主题转到原文没有展开的预算。

conceivably.q: If the wind weakens before noon, the ferry could conceivably resume service this afternoon, but the operator has made no promise. Conceivably most nearly means:
o: 必定
或许
故意
表面

exp.trans: 如果中午前风势减弱，渡轮今天下午有可能恢复运营，但运营方没有作出任何保证。
exp.structure: if从句给出条件：the wind weakens before noon。主句：the ferry + could resume + service；conceivably修饰could resume，降低确定性。but后面的no promise进一步说明并不确定。
exp.other: weaken 减弱；ferry 渡轮；resume service 恢复运营；operator 运营方。
exp.meaning: conceivably = 可以设想地、有可能地，强调可能存在但远未确定。
exp.rest: 必定对应确定性，强于could且与未作承诺冲突；故意描述意图；表面描述外观，都不是这里的可能性。

conceivably.q: The damaged page could conceivably contain the date we need, but the faded ink cannot yet be read. Which claim keeps the writer’s certainty level?
o: 页面上已经确认写有需要的日期。
需要的日期很可能就在这一页，比其他页更有可能。
这页或许写有需要的日期，目前仍未证实。
这页故意省略了日期。

exp.trans: 那张受损的页面或许写有我们需要的日期，但褪色的墨迹目前还无法辨认。准确改写保留可能性，并说明尚未证实。
exp.structure: The damaged page是主语，could contain是谓语，the date是宾语；we need是省略关系代词的定语从句。conceivably修饰可能性；but之后the faded ink + cannot yet be read是被动谓语。
exp.other: damaged 受损的；faded 褪色的；ink 墨迹；certainty 确定程度。
exp.meaning: conceivably表示可以设想有这种可能。它既不是已经确认，也不自动表示比其他方案更可能。
exp.rest: “已经确认”抹掉could与无法辨认的限制；“很可能、比其他页更可能”加入原文没有的概率比较；“故意省略”把可能存在日期误写成有意不写，既换内容又补动机。

nested.skill: 区分定语从句、宾语从句和主句谓语
nested.q: Engineers who noticed that the valve was leaking shut down the line. Which sequence gives the main-clause subject head / who-clause verb / main-clause verb?
o: Engineers / noticed / shut down
the valve / noticed / was leaking
Engineers / was leaking / noticed
the line / shut down / noticed

exp.trans: 注意到阀门漏液的工程师关闭了生产线。按题目要求的顺序，主句主语中心词是Engineers，who从句谓语是noticed，主句谓语是shut down。
exp.structure: 主句骨架是Engineers shut down the line；who noticed...修饰Engineers；that the valve was leaking是noticed的宾语从句。三个谓语分别属于不同层级。
exp.other: engineer 工程师；valve 阀门；leak 漏液；shut down 关闭、停运；subject head 主语中心词。
exp.meaning: 先找主句骨架，再把who定语从句和that宾语从句分别嵌入。阀门是that从句的主语，工程师才是主句主语。
exp.rest: the valve只在that从句中作主语；was leaking属于that宾语从句，不是who从句谓语；the line是shut down的宾语，不是主句主语。

nested.skill: 区分定语从句、宾语从句和主句谓语
nested.q: Editors who learned that the quote was inaccurate removed it from the draft. Which sequence gives the main-clause subject head / who-clause verb / main-clause verb?
o: Editors / learned / removed
the quote / learned / was
Editors / was / learned
the draft / removed / learned

exp.trans: 得知引文不准确的编辑把它从草稿中删掉了。主句主语中心词是Editors，who从句谓语是learned，主句谓语是removed。
exp.structure: 主句骨架是Editors removed it from the draft；who learned...修饰Editors；that the quote was inaccurate是learned的宾语从句。三个谓语属于不同层级。
exp.other: editor 编辑；quote 引文；inaccurate 不准确的；draft 草稿。
exp.meaning: 先找主句骨架，再把who定语从句和that宾语从句分别嵌入。quote是that从句的主语，Editors才是主句主语。
exp.rest: the quote只在that从句中作主语；was属于that宾语从句，不是who从句谓语；the draft是介词from的宾语，不是主句主语。

nested.target: whatever + 名词 / 嵌入式修饰结构
nested.skill: 名词短语内部结构与主句宾语
nested.q: The workshop lets each visiting researcher retain whatever equipment they brought for the project. Which analysis is accurate?
o: The phrase is the subject of lets and refers to the researcher.
The whole phrase is the object of retain; whatever determines equipment.
The phrase is a direct question asking what equipment was brought.
The phrase modifies workshop and explains why the visit occurred.

exp.trans: 工作坊允许每位来访研究人员保留自己为项目带来的任何设备。whatever equipment they brought for the project整体作retain的宾语。
exp.structure: 主句骨架：The workshop lets each visiting researcher retain something。whatever equipment they brought for the project替换something，整体是retain的宾语；whatever限定equipment，they brought for the project修饰equipment。
exp.other: workshop工作坊；visiting researcher来访研究人员；retain保留；equipment设备。
exp.meaning: whatever + 名词可表示“任何……/所……的任何东西”。先识别整个名词短语在主句中的位置，再分析短语内部的限定词和修饰从句。
exp.rest: 主句主语是The workshop，不是whatever短语；这里不是直接疑问句；whatever短语不修饰workshop，也不说明访问原因。

nested.target: whatever + 名词 / 整体作宾语
nested.skill: 名词性结构与从句内部关系
nested.q: The registrar will accept whatever documents the applicant submits before Friday. What role does the underlined phrase play?
o: It is the object of accept: any documents the applicant submits.
It is the subject of submits and refers to the registrar.
It asks which documents the applicant may submit.
It modifies Friday and explains the reason for the deadline.

exp.trans: 登记员会接受申请人在周五之前提交的任何文件。whatever documents the applicant submits整体作accept的宾语。
exp.structure: 主句：The registrar will accept something。whatever documents the applicant submits before Friday整体替代something，作accept的宾语；the applicant submits是修饰documents的限定性关系结构，documents是submits的宾语。
exp.other: registrar登记员；applicant申请人；submit提交；deadline截止时间。
exp.meaning: whatever + 名词表示任何符合后续限定的该类事物；整个短语可以在主句中作宾语。要区分外层动词accept与内层从句谓语submits。
exp.rest: underlined phrase不是submits的主语，内层主语是the applicant；这不是直接疑问句；Friday是before的宾语，不是被whatever短语修饰的对象，也没有说明截止原因。
